title: Parsons crater and 'Jack Parsons Laboratory'

tellings.quote: A lunar crater now bears his name. And at JPL, some insiders still call it Jack Parsons Laboratory.

plain: The rocket pioneer Jack Parsons is said to be honoured in two ways: a crater on the Moon bears his name, and at JPL, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's rocket and spacecraft centre in Pasadena, California, "some insiders still call it Jack Parsons Laboratory." Michels says this himself, without naming a source, as a sign of how central Parsons was to American rocketry.
